Add the tasking documents

Put the terms of reference, briefing requests and client emails in one folder, then drop the folder here. Word, PDF and email files all work. Subfolders are fine.

Drop a folder or files here
or

For emails, select them in your mail program and drag them into a folder first. Attachments inside the emails are read as well.

If your browser asks whether to "upload" the folder, say yes. That only lets this page read the files. They stay on this computer.

Check and download
